releaseNote.summary: r51 shipped July 8 (evening): integration source types, user-scoped lane config, Meta creative comments, live stream socket fix, Slack silent turns, and more. r50 and a hotfix also shipped July 7-8. r52 is in draft.
releaseNote.plannedWindow: r51 live (July 8, 2026 at 3:30 PM ET). r52 is in draft; next release window not yet confirmed.
releaseNote.details: r51 (July 8, 2026, 13 PRs): surfaces integration source types and honest connect requirements with Wrike/YouTube/Adobe in Pipedream, restores runtime auth for preserved routines, upgrades idle Slack conversations to chat v5, adds user-scoped lane config (Knoweth), closes live stream sockets on disconnect, stops steady-state backend health probes fleet-wide, ships Meta creative comments, routes Runneth MCP brain search through agentd, rebases agent config updates onto disk config, delivers typed text as visible Slack output without a start_response, stops retrying Meta insights when no data source exists, hides internal Spawneth I/O errors, and keeps no-response Slack turns silent. Earlier: r50 (July 7) gated Slack visible output behind opt-in; a direct hotfix shipped early July 8. r48 (July 6, 30 PRs) was the large feature release.

notices.summary: After the inner-thinking fix, Slack replies can sometimes go missing.
notices.impact: The July 7 release stopped Runneth from leaking its internal thinking into Slack replies. That fix over-corrected: Runneth now sometimes stays silent when it should reply. A followup fix is in progress.
notices.workaround: If a Slack reply doesn't come through, re-send the message.

resolution.label: Followup fix in progress
resolution.note: The internal-thinking leak was fixed in the July 7 release. It introduced a followup issue where Runneth can skip replying in Slack. A followup fix is being worked on and is not yet in a confirmed release.

notices.summary: Fixed: Meta ad types without a synced creative now return metrics.
notices.impact: Flex, dynamic, catalogue, and product-set ads (any ad without a synced creative asset) used to go missing from Runneth's Meta insights, spend, and rankings, which could differ from a Motion report. They are now included.
notices.workaround: None needed. Those ad types now show up in Runneth's Meta creative insights.

resolution.label: Resolved
resolution.note: Resolved. Feed, dynamic, and other ads that lacked a synced creative asset (including flex, catalogue, and product-set ads) now show up in Runneth's Meta creative insights, spend, and rankings, so Motion and Runneth no longer diverge for those ad types. Shipped in the recent July releases.

notices.summary: Some customers can't connect Slack until their Slack admin changes a setting.
notices.impact: If a customer's Slack workspace only allows apps from the Slack Marketplace, connecting Runneth to Slack will fail. It looks like a Runneth bug, but it is a setting on the customer's own Slack workspace.
notices.workaround: Before filing a Slack connection bug, have the customer's Slack admin open their Slack settings, go to Manage apps, then App Management Settings. Under 'Require apps from Slack Marketplace', click Edit and make sure 'Only Slack Marketplace apps can be installed' is unchecked. Then try connecting again.

resolution.label: Customer-side Slack setting
resolution.note: This is a setting in the customer's own Slack workspace, not a Runneth bug. Once their Slack admin allows apps from outside the Slack Marketplace, the connection works.

notices.statusPageGuidance: Slack connection failures are often a customer-side Slack setting. Have the customer's Slack admin go to Manage apps, then App Management Settings, and uncheck 'Only Slack Marketplace apps can be installed' under 'Require apps from Slack Marketplace' before reporting a bug.
notices.runnethTrigger: User reports that a customer cannot connect Slack, that Slack connection is failing, or asks about Slack connect errors during onboarding.
notices.runnethGuidance: If someone reports a customer cannot connect Slack, point to the customer-side Slack setting first: their Slack admin should go to Slack settings, Manage apps, App Management Settings, and under 'Require apps from Slack Marketplace' uncheck 'Only Slack Marketplace apps can be installed', then retry. Treat this as a likely cause before filing a Runneth bug. Do not raise proactively for normal Slack requests.
notices.supportGuidance: Capture the customer's Slack workspace and the exact connect error. Confirm whether their Slack admin has 'Require apps from Slack Marketplace' enabled; they must disable it (uncheck 'Only Slack Marketplace apps can be installed') under App Management Settings, then retry.
